summary: QA Automation Engineer with 2 years of experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript. Skilled in Page Object Model, fixtures, API testing, cross-browser and parallel execution, and handling flaky tests. Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. I use AI tools such as Claude to generate test cases, speed up framework development, and analyze failed test logs, while reviewing and understanding all code. Comfortable with Git, bug reporting, and working in Agile teams.
